title: Referral for cardiology assessment: Mr Jonas Becker, born 3 July 1961

headings.text: Referral for cardiology assessment: Mr Jonas Becker, born 3 July 1961

key_sentences: Thank you for seeing Mr Becker, a retired bus driver aged 65, who has had episodes of exertional chest tightness for the past eight weeks.
I would be grateful for your assessment of a possible angina and for advice on further investigations.
The episodes come on after about ten minutes of brisk walking and settle within five minutes of rest.
He has had no episodes at rest and no syncope, and there is no history of palpitations.
On examination there was no evidence of heart failure and the chest was clear.
I have asked Mr Becker to avoid strenuous exertion until he has been seen and to use his glyceryl trinitrate spray if symptoms come on.
Please contact me if his symptoms become more frequent or start to occur at rest, and I will arrange an emergency admission.

rows: Normal first and second sounds, no murmurs
Sinus rhythm, no acute ST changes

list_items.text: Hypertension, diagnosed in 2018 and well controlled on treatment.
Ex-smoker; stopped in 2015 after thirty pack years.
Father had a myocardial infarction at the age of 58.
